authority.basis: Product/Power Authority and Molex Multi-Connector Authority V2
authority.scope: source schematic/net contract only; no CAD integration or hardware qualification

connector_contract.contact_assignment: pads 1-3 positive, pads 4-6 return, per pin-1 orientation; harness continuity must verify this assignment
connector_contract.contact_screen_is_not: a guaranteed PiSXMe installed rating or passive-sharing authorization

branch_fault_isolation.method: one positive-series fuse per contact-pair branch
branch_fault_isolation.qualification: I2t is a source-record typical value; exact fault waveform, holder/contact rise, clearing and copper/connector withstand remain validation gates
branch_fault_isolation.explicit_limit: the 15 A fuse is fault isolation, not a 5 A current limiter; normal branch current must be screened <=7 A/contact by balance and thermal evidence

common_protected_stage.topology: after all nine positive fuses join at 12V_BRANCH_JOIN, apply one common TVS and one common reverse-current/ideal-diode stage before 12V_PROTECTED
common_protected_stage.reuse_authority: Existing U1/Q1/D1/C3 cohort may be reused as this single common stage subject to fresh hot resistance, VDS/SOA, TVS-energy, thermal and DRC validation.
common_protected_stage.duplicate_stage_disposition: Existing U2/Q2/D2/C4 are not a second parallel common-bus stage under this contract; producer must DNP/remove/reassign them through schematic review. No passive active-stage sharing is credited.
common_protected_stage.tvs_screen: 18 V standoff; 29.2 V clamp at the retained 20.6 A test point; no automotive load-dump claim
common_protected_stage.stage_gate: The common stage must meet the 2.0 mOhm protection allocation and 10.0 mOhm complete path after hot extraction; reuse is authorization to evaluate, not a closure claim.

control_policy.v100_policy: V100 enable remains inhibited/reset-held whenever protected bus is outside 11.00-12.60 V, source/protection fault is asserted, or controlled shutdown is active.
control_policy.fault_reporting: No new fault IC is invented by this contract. Existing POWER_PG_FAULT sheet interface remains reserved for producer/firmware sequencing authority; fuse opening is passive isolation and must be detected by bus/source observation or an explicitly authorized monitor.

common_bus_contract.return_join: PWR_RET_J5_P4..P6, PWR_RET_J6_P4..P6, PWR_RET_J9_P4..P6 -> POWER_RETURN_JOIN -> POWER_GND and authority-mapped J1 GND field
common_bus_contract.return_rule: Keep nine return identities separate through their owned branch paths and join only at the controlled common return region; do not use signal/shield returns.
common_bus_contract.j1_rule: Only authority-mapped J1 +12V/GND contacts are connected; unknown contacts remain unknown/no-connect.

schematic_ownership.producer_scope: May add/rename the three 2x3 headers, nine branch nets/fuses, common join, and common protection cohort in an isolated candidate only.
schematic_ownership.canonical_integration: Root Foreman serial integration after targeted native ERC/DRC/connectivity and complete-path extraction.
schematic_ownership.authority_review: Product/Power Authority reviews any deviation, especially common protection replacement, branch reference changes, or control/fault policy.

validation_gates: fresh native netlist proves all 18 connector contacts, nine branch pair identities and F1-F9 ownership
no positive branch is directly paralleled before its fuse; no return net is omitted or silently collapsed
each branch current target is 4.444444 A continuous and 5.000000 A for the 100 ms screen; each contact remains <=7 A including uncertainty
all nine branches and all three headers are present; no N-1 credit
fuse I2t/time-current, TVS clamp/energy, common FET SOA/RDS/hot resistance and thermal rise are calculated or measured for the exact installation
effective source harness/connector loop <=4.0 mOhm hot and complete source-to-J1 positive-plus-return <=10.0 mOhm hot
native DRC/opens/shorts and fresh KiCad Light validation at integrated candidate SHA
prototype hardware validation remains required; no production qualification or fabricated measurement is claimed
remaining_gaps: mating 5557 housing/5556 terminals, conductor gauge/length/crimp and installation records must be bound before hardware testing
exact installed fuse I2t/clearing and common-stage FET/TVS SOA/thermal/path resistance are validation gates
POWER_PG_FAULT/fault aggregation truth table and standalone V100 sequencing remain prototype/firmware authority work
